title: Differential testing for C-to-Rust ports
abstract: For an authorized C-to-Rust port, exercise the upstream C executable and Rust replacement with equivalent inputs and environments, then compare outputs, exit status and relevant observable side effects against documented intentional differences.

source.reference: Public-safe generalized C-to-Rust porting proposal; no private source language retained

scope_hints.trigger: An explicitly authorized strict C-to-Rust port
scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only applicable to the agreed upstream baseline, target requirements and observable behavior

unresolved: Confirm this adds a distinct, independently testable requirement without duplicating general port-fidelity or Rust-testing guidance.
remarks: The original public-safe intake is retained; its independently authorized processing produced a published atomic rule, not automatic application.
